Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call today — great context on the ML workloads and the throughput targets for the pilot. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can start a short mutual action plan: 

Summary (from my notes):
- Pilot scope: 3 models (inference-only) + embeddings for search; expected peak 60 qps, mostly P95 under 300ms
- Key decision criteria: sustained latency at scale, cost per 1 million tokens, data residency + auditability, and an SLA for throughput
- Timeline: procurement review starts mid-April, target production decision late-May

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer (who signs budget) and the person who owns the P&L for this initiative?
2) Please share the security/compliance contact who will own SOC2/KMS/audit evidence requests. We can prepare a short security pack and an evidence checklist tailored to what they want.
3) Who in procurement should we loop in for contract/redlines and billing terms?
4) I attached two short artifacts you can share internally: Redwood SLA options (high level) and a one-pager on our data handling controls.

If you prefer, we can book a 30-min call next week with procurement + security to walk through the checklist — I can bring Ben (solutions) and Hannah (security lead).

Cheers,
